sections.text:
هذا المستند يختص
بعمل تفتيش دوري كل ثلاثة شهور لمحول فوجي قدرة 45 م.ف.أ وقد تم إنشاء المستند بمعرفة كل من السيد
المهندس /محمد سليم سالمان والسيد المهندس / سامي محمد حسن وتمت المراسلات
الاليكترونية خلال الانترنت بمساعدة المهندس/ محمد سليم سالمان.

وقد تم تنفيذه بناءً على الخبرة السابقة بمعرفة السيد المهندس / سامي محمد
حسن وتمت مراجعة المستند بمعرفة السيد المهندس / عبودة البنا 
مهندس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة والسيد
المهندس / محمد السيد عبد الغفار مدير عام المحطة واعتماده من السيد المهندس /
عوض محمد فتحي رئيس قطاع المحطات.

items:
إصدار
 أمر شغل معتمد من الجهة المختصة مع كتابة فئة الأمن الصناعي0

اعزل المحول وتأريضه من ناحية الـ 11ك.ف
 والـ 22ك.ف والـ 220ك.ف.

استخدم
 عصا اختبار الجهد للتأكد من عدم وجود جهد على جميع جهات المحول.
ارتدي مهمات الوقاية الشخصية والأمان.

تسوير
 مكان المحول وتأمين الأماكن الخطرة بجانبه ووضع اللوحات الإرشادية.

عصا
 اختبار الجهد.

خوذة
 وحزام الأمان وحذاء الأمان.

بلاور
 وقطع نظيفة من القماش.

فتش على خزان الزيت الرئيسي للمحول وقس
 المنسوب وتسجيله.

فتش عن
 أي آثار تهريب أو بقع زيت على المحول أو بالقرب منه على الأرض.

لاحظ درجات حرارة الملفات وزيت التبريد
 من واقع السجلات.
نظف مراوح التبريد من أي أتربة أو عوالق.
قم بتجربة مراوح التبريد ولاحظ أي ضوضاء أو أصوات غير طبيعية.
فتش على كابينة التشغيل للمحول ونظفها.
فتش على كابينة مغير الجهد ونظفها.
فتش على محتوي السيليكا جيل ولاحظ مدي التغير في لونها.

لاحظ كمية الزيت بأسفل محتوي السيليكا
 جيل ومدي نظافتها.
فتش على عوازل الاختراق ونظفها من أي أتربة ولاحظ مستوى الزيت بها.

افحص جهاز الوقاية الهيدروليكية للمحول
 (بوخلز ريللي) ولاحظ مستوي الزيت به.

تأكد
 من عدم وجود أي ممانعة لإعادة المحول لوضع التشغيل بالخدمة.

إنه
 أمر الشغل ورفع علامات التسوير وإخلي
 الموقع.

إخطر
 التحكم ووضع المحول بالخدمة بعد موافقة التحكم.

sections_en.text: Introduction: This document is the equivalent of T-004-r0a

This document covers a periodic inspection every three months of a Fuji transformer rated 45 MVA. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Sami Mohamed Hassan, and the electronic correspondence over the Internet was carried out with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.

It was implemented on the basis of previous experience by Eng. Sami Mohamed Hassan. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, inspection and quality control engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, general manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, head of the stations sector.

items: Issue a work order approved by the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category 0
Isolate the transformer and earth it from the 11 kV, 22 kV and 220 kV sides.
Use a voltage tester rod to make sure there is no voltage on any side of the transformer.
Wear personal protective and safety equipment.
Fence off the transformer location, secure the hazardous areas beside it, and place the warning signs.
Voltage tester rod.
Safety helmet, safety belt and safety shoes.
Blower and clean pieces of cloth.

sections_en.text: Work Steps to Be Carried Out:

items: Inspect the main oil tank of the transformer, measure the level and record it.
Look for any signs of leakage or oil stains on the transformer or near it on the ground.
Note the winding and cooling oil temperatures from the records.
Clean the cooling fans of any dust or deposits.
Test the cooling fans and note any noise or abnormal sounds.
Inspect the transformer operating cabinet and clean it.
Inspect the tap changer cabinet and clean it.
Inspect the silica gel container and note the extent of change in its colour.
Note the quantity of oil at the bottom of the silica gel container and how clean it is.
Inspect the bushings and clean them of any dust, and note the oil level in them.
Check the transformer hydraulic protection device (Buchholz relay) and note the oil level in it.
Make sure there is nothing preventing the transformer from being returned to service.
Close the work order, remove the fencing signs and clear the site.
Notify Control and put the transformer in service after Control's approval.

Introduction: This document is the equivalent of T-004-r0a
This document covers a periodic inspection every three months of a Fuji transformer rated 45 MVA. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Sami Mohamed Hassan, and the electronic correspondence over the Internet was carried out with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented on the basis of previous experience by Eng. Sami Mohamed Hassan. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, inspection and quality control engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, general manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, head of the stations sector.
Safety Precautions:
Issue a work order approved by the competent authority, stating the industrial safety category 0
Isolate the transformer and earth it from the 11 kV, 22 kV and 220 kV sides.
Use a voltage tester rod to make sure there is no voltage on any side of the transformer.
Wear personal protective and safety equipment.
Fence off the transformer location, secure the hazardous areas beside it, and place the warning signs.
Tools and Equipment Used:
Voltage tester rod.
Safety helmet, safety belt and safety shoes.
Blower and clean pieces of cloth.
Work Steps to Be Carried Out:
Inspect the main oil tank of the transformer, measure the level and record it.
Look for any signs of leakage or oil stains on the transformer or near it on the ground.
Note the winding and cooling oil temperatures from the records.
Clean the cooling fans of any dust or deposits.
Test the cooling fans and note any noise or abnormal sounds.
Inspect the transformer operating cabinet and clean it.
Inspect the tap changer cabinet and clean it.
Inspect the silica gel container and note the extent of change in its colour.
Note the quantity of oil at the bottom of the silica gel container and how clean it is.
Inspect the bushings and clean them of any dust, and note the oil level in them.
Check the transformer hydraulic protection device (Buchholz relay) and note the oil level in it.
Make sure there is nothing preventing the transformer from being returned to service.
Close the work order, remove the fencing signs and clear the site.
Notify Control and put the transformer in service after Control's approval.
Record the transformer data in the attached table
